title: Korah
summary: Raleigh names Korah in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Korah, named with Dathan and Abiram in the mutiny. The sonnes of Korah who carried the Sanctuarie were left on this record, and were not moved to Kohath. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
